subject: Next steps: ownership matrix, contracts path & intro chain
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@medops.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: ownership matrix, contracts path & intro chain

Jacob — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on approvals and timeline.

Meeting recap (high level)
- Use case: clinical summarization & patient intake flows (pilot 3 clinics, then expand)
- Primary decision criteria: latency under 400ms 90th pct, on-prem options for PHI, predictable per-token cost, SOC2 + audit logs
- Pilot success metric: 8-week pilot with error rate <4% on redaction and <2% hallucination on structured prompts

Immediate asks / what we need from you
1) Economic buyer + contract path: who signs vs who influences? Can you confirm the person who signs the PO (title/name)?
2) Legal / procurement contacts: to speed contracting and security review — can you share the best points of contact or an internal intro?
3) Org map or a short roster: a 1‑page list of stakeholders across Clinical Ops, IT/Security, Procurement, Legal (name + title + email + approval role)

What we’ll deliver this week
- Draft ownership matrix (who owns each approval + suggested approver order) — attached template: ownership-matrix-template.xlsx
- High-level commercial skeleton and pilot SOW for procurement review
- Red-team checklist and initial answers to security questionnaire (will send once we have the security contact)

Suggested timeline
- By Mon 9/27: your intro to procurement & legal or the org roster
- By Wed 9/29: Redwood delivers draft SOW + ownership matrix + NDA

Attachments: [ownership-matrix-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — I’ll wait to hear the procurement/legal names and the economic owner so we don’t miss any steps.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@medops.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: ownership matrix, contracts path & intro chain

Thanks Kim — appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers and requests below.

Economic buyer:
- That would be Markus Eberhardt, VP Finance & Ops (he signs larger vendor agreements). I’ll introduce but FYI he prefers procurement handle the initial redlines.

Legal / Procurement contacts to loop:
- Priya Menon, Head of Procurement (procurement@medops.com) — she manages SOWs and PO flow
- Markus Eberhardt (markus.e@medops.com) — will be involved for final approval on commercial terms

Security / Compliance:
- We have a centralized security questionnaire owner but it’s handled by IT Security; I’ll get the contact in the intro.

Requests from us:
- Can you share a draft SOW (pilot scope + success criteria) and a ballpark TCO for a 3‑clinic pilot (incl. forecasted tokens/month and expected cost range)? Procurement will need that to size the PO.
- Please include a short summary of data residency options & PHI handling for the pilot.

I’ll make the intros once I get your permission to include Priya and Markus on the thread. If you want, include the ownership matrix in that intro so procurement can see the proposed approver sequence.

Jacob
Director, Clinical Programs
MedOps Health
jacob.lin@medops.com | +1 312-555-0146

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: ownership matrix, contracts path & intro chain

Kim — quick internal note before you loop Priya/Markus. A suggested approach that has worked at similar accounts:

1) Confirm economic buyer (Markus) but treat Jacob as product champion / influencer. We should ask Markus two specific things in the intro: approval threshold (dollar value that requires board sign-off) and preferred payment terms.

2) Procurement intro (Priya): include the draft SOW + ownership matrix + commercial skeleton. Procurement will ask for line items and a PO-ready cost table (monthly vs one-time). Attach the procurement-checklist.docx as a friendly reference.

3) Legal intro / NDA: keep the first exchange light — provide our standard NDA (attached) and ask legal for contract redlines with a 5‑business‑day review expectation.

4) Security questionnaires: do not send the full SOC/Sec questionnaire until we have the security contact; instead offer the high-level security brief (data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, SOC2 attestation). Offer an optional security call with our secops lead.

Suggested language for the intro email (short):
"Jacob — thanks. Per your note, looping in Priya (Procurement) and Markus (VP Finance) so they can see the proposed pilot SOW and ownership matrix. Kimberly from Redwood will share a draft SOW, a PO-ready cost table, and our standard NDA. Priya/Markus — would love a quick read on preferred next steps for procurement and approval timelines"

I can be on the procurement call if you want. Also confirm whether to CC Aditya for pricing questions (I recommend yes).

Sergio
Head of Sales, West | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@medops.com>, Priya Menon <priya@medops.com>, Markus Eberhardt <markus.e@medops.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro: procurement & finance — pilot SOW + ownership matrix (MedOps x Redwood)

Jacob / Priya / Markus — thanks for agreeing to connect. Per Jacob’s note, I’m sharing the initial artifacts to kick off procurement & legal review.

Attached:
- ownership-matrix-template.xlsx (proposed approver order and owner for each approval item)
- NDA-draft-v1.pdf (our standard mutual NDA; light redlines expected)
- procurement-checklist.docx (helpful checklist with suggested PO line items)

Short ask from Priya / Markus:
- Priya: can you confirm the PO data your system needs (line-item format, GL codes if required, preferred billing cadence)?
- Markus: what approval threshold would require additional sign-off (e.g., >$X)? Also any timing constraints we should be aware of for end-of-quarter procurement runs?

What we’re sending next (target Wed 9/29):
- Pilot SOW (scope, success criteria, timeline)
- PO-ready pricing table (monthly token tiers + pilot estimate)
- Short security brief (data residency & PHI handling) and an option to schedule a 30‑minute security sync with our secops lead

If helpful, here’s a proposed 10‑day cadence: procurement reads + redlines (5 days), we respond (3 days), signatures (2 days) — flexible based on your review velocity.

Please reply with the best day/time for a 30‑minute procurement sync this week if you'd like live coordination.

Thanks everyone — looping Priya and Markus per Jacob’s request.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: [ownership-matrix-template.xlsx, NDA-draft-v1.pdf, procurement-checklist.docx]
